question_types_in_exam.summary: UP Board Class 10 Science paper mein 2 parts hain — Part A (MCQ/Objective, OMR) aur Part B (Descriptive, Answer Booklet)

types.how_to_attempt: Sirf correct option ka circle fill karo OMR par. Kaat-chhat ya whitener nahi chalega.

types.word_limit: 50–80 words for theory; show full working for numericals

books.book_name: NCERT Science (Vigyan) — Chemical Substances — Nature and Behaviour

topics: Types of chemical reactions: combination, decomposition, displacement, double displacement
Effects of oxidation in everyday life (rancidity, corrosion)
Salts — common salt, baking soda, washing soda, bleaching powder, plaster of paris
Physical and chemical properties of metals
Extraction of metals — highly, moderately, least reactive
Alloys — definition, examples (brass, bronze, solder, steel)
Functional groups: alcohol (-OH), aldehyde (-CHO), ketone (-CO-), carboxylic acid (-COOH)
Modern periodic table — periods and groups
Trends in periodic table (atomic size, metallic character, valency)
Human digestive system — alimentary canal, bile juice secreted by liver
Respiration: aerobic and anaerobic, glycolysis in cytoplasm
Transportation: human heart structure, blood vessels
Excretion: nephron, kidney (excretory system organ = kidney)
Asexual reproduction: fission, budding, regeneration, fragmentation, vegetative propagation
Buds on leaf: Bryophyllum, Mint, Potato (all of the above)
Human male and female reproductive systems
Mendel's laws — monohybrid and dihybrid cross
Gene = section of DNA providing information for protein synthesis
Plant hormones: Auxin, Cytokinin, Gibberellin, Abscisic acid
Concave and convex mirrors — image formation
Convex mirror: image always virtual, erect, between pole and focus
Concave mirror uses: shaving mirror, headlights, torch
Human eye: cornea, iris, pupil, retina — image forms on retina
Dispersion of light — prism, colour farthest from base = violet
When light goes from denser to rarer medium — moves away from normal

books.book_name: NCERT Science (Vigyan) — Current Effect (Electricity and Magnetism)

topics: Domestic electric wiring: live (red/brown), neutral (black/blue), earth (green/yellow)
Magnetic field due to current-carrying conductor
Right-hand thumb rule / Fleming's left-hand rule
Magnetic field lines — properties, do not intersect
Unit of magnetic field intensity = Newton/Ampere-metre (N/Am)
Factors affecting magnetic field of current-carrying conductor
Solar energy, wind energy, hydropower, nuclear energy
Artificial ecosystem example: Agriculture land formed by humans

important_diagrams_masterlist.note: Science — diagrams / maps / visual aids to practise.

must_practise.diagram_name: Refraction diagram (angle of incidence/refraction with two media)

targets.strategy: Part A ke 20 MCQ mein se 15+ pakke aane chahiye NCERT padhkar. Part B Sub-Section I ke easy numerical se 4-6 marks. Total ~21-26 marks easily.
focus_chapters: Ch 2 (Acids/Bases — pH, litmus, baking soda easy facts)
Ch 6 (Life Processes — ATP, bile, blood pressure — MCQ facts)
Ch 10 & 11 (Light MCQs — convex mirror, violet prism, retina)

targets.strategy: Part A (15+ marks) + Sub-Section I numericals (8 marks) + Sub-Section II short answers (8 marks) = ~31-40 marks.
focus_chapters: Ch 4 (Carbon compounds — structural formulae of 4-5 key compounds)

targets.strategy: Part A (18+ marks) + Part B full sub-sections (42 marks) = 60 marks. Prepare all diagrams.
focus_chapters: Ch 10 & 11 (Full light — all numericals, human eye, defects)
Ch 4 (Full carbon — IUPAC, structural formulae, reactions)

targets.strategy: Sab chapters complete. Diagrams perfect with labels. Previous 5 years papers solve karo. OR questions dono options prepare karo.
extra_focus_areas: Refractive index calculation using sin angles
Electron count in circuit (Q = It, then n = Q/e)
Chemical equations — all reaction types with balancing
Copper extraction from Cu2S with equations
Autotrophic vs heterotrophic — full comparison table
Pond ecosystem — all components with examples
